# Style and event attributes

<div style="background:url(https://example.com/pixel.png)">style url</div>

<p style="position:fixed;top:0;left:0;width:100%;height:100%">overlay</p>

<div onclick="alert(1)" onmouseover="alert(2)">handlers</div>

<details open ontoggle="alert(3)"><summary>x</summary>y</details>

<input autofocus onfocus="alert(4)">

<a href="https://example.com" target="_blank" onauxclick="alert(5)">link</a>
